setup.title: Prepare your battle
setup.description: Configure your army and prepare a new match against the AI.
setup.armyHelp: Choose your troops' visual identity. The selection applies to the unit list, deployment and battlefield.
setup.name: Battle name

load.title: Load battle
load.description: Enter a battle ID to recover its state and continue the campaign.

armyBuilder.title: Army composition
armyBuilder.help: You have {{total}} grain units. Troop types may be repeated while the army stays within budget.

ai.recruitmentPhase: Deciding whether to recruit a new army…
ai.deploymentSpace: Free deployment hexes in the capital's region: {{count}}.
ai.thinking: Rivals are deciding whether to recruit a new army…
ai.failed: The local model could not complete a decision. You can retry or skip it for this turn.
ai.skipped: Decision skipped by the player; no recruitment this turn.

campaign.disbandHelp: All troops in this army will be removed and will stop consuming grain. Recruitment grain is not refunded. This action cannot be undone.
campaign.disbanded: {{name}} has been disbanded and no longer consumes grain.

cityActions.title: City actions
cityActions.raidHelp: Loot: {{grain}} grain, once per year. The city loses that year's harvest.
cityActions.raided: City raided this year. It will produce no grain at Harvest, even if the army leaves.
cityActions.estimate: Assault: {{turns}} turns with your current troops. Each turn costs 5% casualties, rounded up.
cityActions.lossesHelp: Each assault turn causes 5% casualties among surviving troops, rounded up. Abundance recovery is suspended during the assault. Leaving loses your progress.
cityActions.raidStarted: {{city}} raided. Loot: {{grain}} grain. Production cancelled for this year and movement spent this season.
cityActions.assaultStarted: Assault on {{city}} started. The army has spent its movement for this season.
cityActions.cancelled: Action interrupted. Spent movement resets next season.

campaign.startHelp: Start a new campaign or continue a saved game.
campaign.newCampaignHelp: Choose your nation and start from scratch with a new game ID.
campaign.loadCampaignHelp: Browse your saves and resume any game from its last turn.
campaign.saveListHelp: Each game is saved automatically in this browser with its own ID.
campaign.noSaves: There are no saved campaigns yet. Start a new campaign to begin.
campaign.saveFailed: The campaign registry could not be accessed. Check that your browser allows saved data.
campaign.loadFailed: This game could not be loaded. Its save is unavailable or invalid.
campaign.chooseNationHelp: Your chosen nation determines which troops you can recruit throughout the campaign.
campaign.nationProgress: You will start a new game with 100 grain and no armies. Your saved campaigns will be kept.
campaign.fogHelp: Vision: all enemy armies in your territory are visible with their unit counts. Outside it: enemies at 2 hexes show ?; adjacent enemies show unit counts. Terrain is clear within 1 hex of your armies.

situations.famine: Situation: famine, units suffer 5% casualties per turn.
situations.scarcity: Situation: scarcity, units neither recover nor suffer supply casualties.
situations.abundance: Situation: abundance, units recover 5% of their casualties per turn, except during an assault.

campaign.productionActive: Each city contributes 2 to 8 grain to reserves at the end of Harvest, once a year. Other hexes generate no grain. Capitals are marked with a star.
campaign.difficultMovement: Movement: 1 hex; ends movement for the turn
campaign.normalMovement: Movement follows the army's average speed
campaign.title: Egyptian campaign
campaign.deployInCapital: The army will deploy on a free hex in the region of {{city}}, your capital.
campaign.capitalOccupied: No free hexes remain in the capital's region. Free one to deploy a new army.
campaign.wholeHexes: Weighted average by unit count; only whole hexes can be crossed. Entering or leaving desert or mountains ends movement. Movement resets each season.
campaign.insufficientGrain: Not enough grain remains to recruit more troops.
campaign.empty: Select your capital to recruit your first army and deploy it there.
campaign.savedLocally: Progress is saved automatically in this browser.
campaign.storageError: The campaign could not be saved in this browser. This session's progress will be lost when you close the page.
campaign.moveHint: Choose a highlighted hex to move the selected army.
campaign.selectHint: Select an army in the list or on the map.
campaign.mapHelp: Click a hex to inspect its terrain and attrition. Armies travel over land.
campaign.recruited: Army recruited and deployed on the map.
campaign.movementRestored: New season. All armies recover their movement.

combat.pending: A battle is pending. Resolve it to continue the campaign.
combat.failed: The battle could not be opened. You can try again.

campaign.deleteHelp: Game {{id}} as {{nation}} and its progress saved in this browser will be deleted. This action cannot be undone.
campaign.deleteFailed: The campaign could not be deleted. Please try again.

battle.enemyFormationDeployingDetail: The enemy commander is organizing their troops.
battle.selectInstruction: Select a unit and then a cell inside your deployment zone.
battle.dragInstruction: Drag a unit from the left panel into your deployment zone.
battle.inspectInstruction: Select a unit on the battlefield to inspect its status and characteristics.
battle.armyStatus: Troops and morale of both armies
battle.defeatThreshold: Automatic defeat if troops and morale are both below {{value}}%
battle.criticalDefeatThreshold: Automatic defeat with total morale below {{value}}%, regardless of troops
battle.autoDefeatRule: Immediate defeat for either army when troops and total morale are both below 33%, or total morale is below 10% regardless of troops.
battle.encounterDescription: The adjacent units are ready to resolve their melee combat.
battle.rangedEncounterDescription: The unit will attack at range and consume one projectile. The defender will not retaliate.
battle.meleeOnly: Combat resolution is currently available only against an enemy in an orthogonally adjacent cell.
battle.combatResult: The attacker suffers {{attacker}} casualties and the defender {{defender}} casualties.

unitTurnState.finished: Unit has no movement or attacks available

battle.pendingMovementMessage: {{count}} units have not moved yet. Do you want to advance the turn anyway?
battle.dontShowTurnWarningAgain: Do not show this warning again during this battle
battle.moveInstruction: Select a deployed unit to reposition it.
battle.startedInstruction: Select a unit to see its movement; enemies within attack range are highlighted in red.
battle.deploymentComplete: Deployment complete. You can now begin.

reasons.ANNIHILATION: The defeated army has no surviving soldiers.

errors.UNIT_CANNOT_ATTACK: One of the units cannot participate in combat.

errors.TARGET_OUT_OF_RANGE: The target is outside this unit's range.
